menu.brawlcore.quick_host.tooltip: Creates a new world and opens it to other players immediately - no need to press Create New World.
message.brawlcore.hosted: Quick Host: your world is open to other players on port %s.
message.brawlcore.hosted.essential: Quick Host: world is open on port %s. Essential detected - use Essential's own invite/friends menu from the pause screen if you want friends outside your network to join.
message.brawlcore.host_failed: Quick Host: could not open the world to other players.
